intent_record.intent_summary: Fix incorrect array size reference in tegra234_aon_fabric initialization to use the correct target map instead of BPMP's.
intent_record.what: Changed ARRAY_SIZE argument from tegra234_bpmp_target_map to tegra234_aon_target_map on line 893 in the T234_AON_FABRIC_ID array initialization.
intent_record.how: This fix ensures the AON fabric lookup entry correctly reports the size of its own target map (tegra234_aon_target_map) instead of incorrectly using the BPMP fabric's target map size. This prevents potential buffer overruns or incorrect iteration bounds when processing AON fabric targets at runtime.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix incorrect array size calculation for BPMP fabric target map by using the correct tegra241_bpmp_target_map instead of tegra241_cbb_target_map.
intent_record.what: Changed the second argument of ARRAY_SIZE() macro call from `tegra241_cbb_target_map` to `tegra241_bpmp_target_map` in the T234_BPMP_FABRIC_ID array initialization.
intent_record.how: This fix corrects the size calculation for the BPMP fabric target map. Previously, the code was incorrectly using the size of the CBB target map instead of the BPMP target map, which would cause the BPMP fabric initialization to report an incorrect array size, potentially leading to out-of-bounds access or incomplete initialization of BPMP fabric resources.
